definitions.explanation: An event or circumstance that serves as the starting point for something new.

examples.english: Taking this opportunity; with this as a starting point.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}を{契機|けいき}に{生活|せいかつ}を{見直|みなお}した。
examples.english: I reconsidered my lifestyle, triggered by the illness.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}を{契機|けいき}に{転職|てんしょく}した。
examples.english: I changed jobs, taking the occasion of my marriage.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{失敗|しっぱい}を{契機|けいき}として、{会社|かいしゃ}は{品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}の{体制|たいせい}を{大幅|おおはば}に{改善|かいぜん}した。
examples.english: Taking this failure as an opportunity, the company significantly improved its quality control system.

notes:
{契機|けいき} marks a turning point or catalyst.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{契機|けいき}に (taking ~ as an opportunity)
- 〜を{契機|けいき}として (with ~ as a catalyst)
- 〜が{契機|けいき}となって (~ became the trigger)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {契機|けいき}: catalyst, trigger (formal)
- きっかけ: opportunity, trigger (conversational)
- {機会|きかい}: opportunity, chance

NOTE: {契機|けいき} is more formal than きっかけ and often used in written language.
